axioms: A Tool uses an Algorithm that is named and published.
A Tool may have modifications to the Algorithm it uses.
Software that provides XML editing edits the XML format.
Software has a type such as API or Desktop application.
Software can perform a specific task.
Software may be available as a web service.
Software has functionality that matches a user's need or task.
A software tool created some data.
Software can work with user's data to support a task.
Software has input and output formats.
Software can read a .cel file.
Software has valid input.
Software can export from proprietary format to open formats like csv, txt.
Software A can work with data output from Software B.
Open source, maintained software can process a given format.
For a given input, a software version has data exports.
Software has a download location.
Software provides a help resource.
Software was developed by a developer.
Software has a homepage.
Developers of software may offer collaboration.
Software can be obtained from a URL.
Software has a release date to determine its age.
Active development is indicated by recent versions and release dates.
Software has a version.
A version of software has new features.
Version 1.0 has a release date.
Software may have open source development and community development.
Software has a license with a permissiveness level.
Software has a license that indicates if it is open source.
Software has a license that indicates if it is FOSS.
Software has a license that indicates if it is free.
Software has documentation.
Software is implemented in a programming language.
Software runs on a platform.
